warnings: *** บัวหัวเสาทั่วไป AND บัวหัวเสา ARE TWO SEPARATE DETAILS WITH ALMOST THE SAME NAME, both at 1:20 on this sheet, and they carry the same 0.10 / 0.03 / 0.02 projection sequence but different overall heights. The word ทั่วไป (general) on the first suggests it is the default and the second a variant, but the sheet does not say which column takes which. Recorded as two elements with the printed names kept distinct; no rule was invented about where each applies.

บัว 0.05 ม. IS CALLED OUT ON A-06's ELEVATION with ดูแบบขยาย and no target sheet. The บัวทั่วไป profile here is 0.115 m overall with a 0.05 m top face, so the A-06 callout most likely means this detail - but 0.05 matches only one dimension of it, so the link is stated here and NOT written into A-06 as a resolved reference.

THIS IS THE LAST ARCHITECTURAL SHEET (A-17 of 17) AND IT IS PURE PROFILE WORK - no room, no level, no grid reference appears on it, so it carries no grid_source. Every element is a moulding cross-section.

The finest dimensions here (0.015, 0.01) are at the same resolution limit flagged on A-10's baluster profile. They are recorded as printed rather than rounded; anyone casting the mouldings should work from the full-size sheet.
